title: Adult Ceramics Membership
source_quote:
Ceramics Membership (Ongoing Monthly)

Adult Studio Membership
evidence_sentence: Members have access to the cone 10 gas reduction kiln at Slowfire West for oxidation and reduction firing.
evidence_quote: Members also have access to three clay body options and can fire work in both electric kilns and our cone 10 gas reduction kiln at Slowfire West, allowing artists to explore both oxidation and reduction firing at no additional firing cost.
summary: Monthly membership for intermediate to advanced potters with members-only access to cone 10 gas reduction and electric kilns.
